params.comment: Fake example data: replace each file under inputs/ and each allowance below with your own. One entry carries the params for all six Credits metrics, because Git Crafter merges a targets file's params key by key (quality/overlay.mjs). A relative path is read from your repo's root, ~/ is home, and a path from / is absolute. The pack's own catalog sits under .code-os-packs/SoulCraft-Org/compute-crafter, where a local run expects the pack. Every other key: targets/credits.json in the pack.
